body: Attack the strongest invariant: once the circuit WorkGraph item is satisfied, every later invocation is replay-only and creates no additional effect or native receipt. Start from the retained fixture, record receipt/transition/artifact counts, invoke repeatedly, then perturb ProviderGraph so the recorded provider no longer wins and attempt a content-valid producer relabel. Expected behavior is fail-closed owner inconsistency with unchanged effect, receipt, and artifact counts. Emit a counterexample if any mutation occurs or a relabelled producer is accepted as the original execution. Also probe the adjacent crash window after native effect commit but before circuit-receipt satisfaction.
subject: Attack replay-only re-entry and producer-identity separation
